# CANDIDATE: ORB_VWAP_RIBBON_BREAK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An opening range break above VWAP with a bullish EMA ribbon (9,20,50) and volume surge indicates institutional participation and follow-through momentum. This setup captures early-session trending moves by requiring confluence of price structure (ORB), value area (VWAP), momentum (EMA ribbon), and participation (volume surge).

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Within 09:30-10:00 ET, price breaks above the opening range high (ORH) with volume > 1.5x the average volume of the first 5-minute bars, price > VWAP, and EMA ribbon bullish (price above 9,20,50 EMAs) on the same bar.  
**Exit:** Chart-stop at opening range low (ORL) for structure invalidation. TP1 at 1.5R (risk-reward). Runner trailed 10% below highest-watermark using Chandelier exit (ATR*3).  
**Regime filters:** VIX < 20, time 09:30-10:30 ET, and price must stay above VWAP for ≥5 minutes post-entry to confirm trending bias.
